summary: Comprehensive backend (37/37 pytest) and frontend (mobile viewport) testing of PESO-Link MisOr completed. All critical role-based flows for Job Seeker, Employer (approved + pending), and PESO Admin work end-to-end. Login, role-based redirect to dashboards, NSRP profile, simulated OCR with assistive notice, job browsing/filters, job details with rule-based skill comparison (no ranking), application submission, my-applications with status badges, employer dashboard with pending-approval banner, admin stats + employer approvals page all verified visually.

issues: Minor typo: '2 vacancyies' should be '2 vacancies' or '2 vacancy(ies)' — pluralization bug in job detail header

action_items: Fix minor typo in seeker job detail screen: '2 vacancyies' (should be 'vacancies'). Likely in /app/frontend/app/(seeker)/job/[id].tsx where the string is built from 'vacancy' + 'ies'.
Clean up TEST_ prefixed seed data created during register tests (2 TEST_emp_* employers now show in admin pending list).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend job_type values in schema use hyphen ('full-time','part-time','contract','temporary'); frontend filter chips and UI use the same hyphenated form (verified). The seeded data is consistent. No fix needed.

/api/job-seeker/skills expects payload shape {skills: [{skill_id, proficiency_level}]} — main agent should ensure frontend profile screen sends this shape (Skills chip selector on profile screen was visible but not interactively tested).
/api/nsrp/confirm requires {confirmed_data: {...}} wrapper — main agent should verify upload-nsrp.tsx wraps fields in confirmed_data when calling.
Pending employer's POST /api/employer/jobs returns 403 correctly. Frontend dashboard shows the 'Pending Approval' banner properly.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all visited screens render and integrate correctly; minor typo in job detail

seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_seeker_* and 2 TEST_emp_* accounts via register tests. These accumulate; recommend rerunning seed.js if a clean state is needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend at https://peso-link-misor.preview.emergentagent.com — Node.js+Express+MySQL. test_credentials.md is accurate. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is used by the Expo frontend (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). All 37 backend tests pass. Frontend uses testIDs: login-cta, login-email, login-password, login-submit, register-cta, seeker-dashboard, action-jobs, action-profile, action-upload, action-applications, action-notifications, app-card-{id}, employer-dashboard, action-manage, action-new, emp-job-{id}, admin-dashboard, admin-approvals, admin-jobs, admin-apps, job-{id}, job-search, filter-*, cover-letter, apply-btn. Mobile viewport 390x844 used. MOCKED: /api/nsrp/extract returns simulated OCR data (returns profile-based fallbacks; flagged in response notice). This is intentional per spec.
rca_of_issue: No real bugs encountered. The 5 initial pytest failures were all test-payload shape mismatches (skills wrapper key, confirmed_data wrapper, job_type enum value 'full-time' with hyphen vs underscore, applicant id key name). Fixed in tests after reading route source code.
